title: Review of Coverage Adequacy of MediShield Life and Advisory Support to Minimise Buying of Unnecessary Coverage
what_it_is: Review of Coverage Adequacy of MediShield Life and Advisory Support to Minimise Buying of Unnecessary Coverage

sections.label: MediShield Life Council review
sections.summary: The MediShield Life Council is reviewing the scheme to keep protecting Singaporeans against large medical bills as bill sizes rise and healthcare evolves.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The MediShield Life Council is currently undertaking a comprehensive review of the scheme.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The key objective is to ensure that it continues to protect Singaporeans against large medical bills, amidst rising bill sizes and the evolving healthcare landscape.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: This means that coverage may broaden and claim limits may need to go up, to give Singaporeans greater peace of mind should they encounter a major health episode.

sections.label: IP patients using subsidised care
sections.summary: About half of patients with IP and rider protection use subsidised public healthcare for hospitalisation or day surgery.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: To illustrate, about half of patients with IP and rider protection end up using subsidised public healthcare for hospitalisation or day surgery.

sections.label: MOH publishing IP premium comparison
sections.summary: MOH began publishing a comparison of indicative lifetime premiums across IPs this year.

sentences.speaker: The Minister of State for Health (Ms Rahayu Mahzam) (for the Minister for Health)
sentences.text: The Ministry of Health (MOH) also began publishing a comparison of indicative lifetime premiums across IPs this year.

sections.label: Update on IP portability study
sections.summary: A Member asks when MOH might give a further update on the study into making Integrated Shield Plan insurance portable.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: Can I ask Minister, previously I asked about making Integrated Shield Plan insurance portable, to give consumers choice and rebalance the relationship between consumers and insurers.

sentences.speaker: Dr Tan Wu Meng (Jurong)
sentences.text: Can I ask when MOH might be able to give a further update on this study?

sections.label: Findings shared by year end
sections.summary: MOH intends to share its findings by the end of the year, noting insurer uncertainty about risk may raise premiums.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: Because when each insurer is uncertain about the risk that they have to bear, premiums may actually go up and all in all this may not be helpful.

sentences.speaker: Ms Rahayu Mahzam
sentences.text: And to answer the Member's question, we are intending to share our findings by the end of the year.
